title: Surface engineering of SnO2 for improved perovskite/SnO2 photodetectors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16865-16873
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10121B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jing Cai, Guipeng Li, Yulong Ying, Hongping Li, Ahmad Fairuz Omar, Marzaini Rashid, Mingming Chen
Surface engineering with (NH4)2WS4 passivates surface oxygen vacancies in SnO2 and suppresses I and Pb vacancies at the bottom surface of MAPbI3 thin films, resulting in high-performance MAPbI3/SnO2 heterojunction photodetectors.
